# Glossary {#sec-glossary .unnumbered}

```{r, include = FALSE}
source("global_stuff.R")
```

Each entry gives the definition the book uses and the chapter that defines it. The definitions match the chapter text word for word or nearly so, so a definition you learn here is the one the chapter uses.

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis
gl <- yaml::read_yaml("glossary.yml", fileEncoding = "UTF-8")
chapter_files <- c("01-Data_Description.qmd", "02-Correlation.qmd", "03-SamplesPopulations.qmd",
                   "04-Foundation_Inference.qmd", "05-Hypothesis_Testing.qmd", "06-ttests.qmd",
                   "07-Nonparametric.qmd", "08-ANOVA.qmd", "09-Regression.qmd",
                   "10-FactorialANOVA.qmd", "11-ANCOVA.qmd")
sort_key <- function(x) tolower(gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9]", "", x))
gl <- gl[order(sapply(gl, function(e) sort_key(e$term)))]
first_letter <- function(e) toupper(substr(gsub("[^A-Za-z]", "", e$term), 1, 1))
current <- ""
for (e in gl) {
  L <- first_letter(e)
  if (L != current) {
    cat("\n## ", L, " {.unnumbered}\n\n", sep = "")
    current <- L
  }
  ch <- sprintf("[Chapter %d](%s)", e$chapter, chapter_files[e$chapter])
  if (!is.null(e$see)) {
    cat(e$term, "\n:   See *", e$see, "*.\n\n", sep = "")
  } else {
    cat(e$term, "\n:   ", e$definition, " (", ch, ")\n\n", sep = "")
  }
}
```
